newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Cemig maintained as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cemig maintained as a buy.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio, an associate of Salomon Brothers, said it has reiterated its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian power company Cemig, which is controlled by Minas Gerais state.

-- The bank also raised its 1996 and 1997 earnings forecasts for the firm to $305 million and $330 million respectively, from its previous estimates of $207 million for this year and $218 million for next year.
- Patrimonio cited Cemig's robust $145 million first-half net profit, compared with its estimate of between $110 million and $115 million.
-- "The main reason for this number is a significant gain in its operating costs," the bank said.
-- It also cited Minas Gerais's planned sale of 33 percent of Cemig voting common stock, a process it expects to be concluded before year's end.
-- "This process should continue to favorably affect the stock, on expectation that Cemig's competitiveness will improve," Patrimonio said.
-- Cemig common shares rose 0.01 reais to 36.50 reais while its preferred rose 0.10 reais to 36.70 reais at 1426 local/1726 gmt on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
